## How it works

 Rip packs of digital trading cards. Each card is an NFT wallet (ERC-6551) holding tokenized stocks, like 114.28 SpaceX shares worth $18,933.
 Hold it like a stock, or sell it back instantly for 95% of its value.
 Anyone can load the machine. Stockists deposit tokenized stocks and earn commission on every rip.
 Every card in the machine is public and pulls are provably fair, so you can see what's in stock before you rip.
 No crypto experience needed. Email, Apple or social sign-up, gas on us. Or bring your own wallet.

## Our wedge

Digital pack rippers. $324M of packs were ripped in June 2026, and 90% of the cardboard was sold straight back. Same habit, better outcome.

Traction (live on Robinhood Chain since July 2026) [...] hackquest logo

# StockRip

The Original Stock Trading Cards. Rip packs of digital trading cards packed with tokenized stocks. Hold them, or sell back instantly for 95% of their value. Live on Robinhood Chain since July.

## Description

Gamblers lose $712 Billion a year, and 52% of Gen Z investors bet instead of investing. StockRip keeps the thrill of a pack rip, but every pull is a position.

## How it works [...] Traction (live on Robinhood Chain since July 2026)

 $1.51M gross protocol revenue
 $1.31M paid to stockists
 $201k protocol earnings
 35,000+ rips

## Why Robinhood Chain and Arbitrum

Robinhood Chain is built on Arbitrum and is home to Robinhood's stock tokens. Fast, cheap transactions make single-card rips viable, and every card, pull and payout is onchain.

## What's next

Launching the Web2.5 app with riplinks. Then products native to each market, all containing stocks: blind boxes, loot drops, lottery tickets and bet slips. The goal is to turn $712 Billion a year of gambling losses into investing gains.
